bellRate.what: Crashes hurting a child walking or biking within 600 ft of a school's grounds, per 1,000 hours, on school days 2022-23 to 2025-26 at 207 schools. Bell hours run from 45 minutes before the start bell to 15 after, and 15 minutes before the end bell to 45 after, at each school's own SFUSD bell times (8:15 am and 3:15 pm where SFUSD lists none). Counts are summed over schools, so a crash near two schools counts twice.

byDistance.what: Kids aged 5 to 18 hurt on SF weekdays, 6 am to 6 pm, August to May, school years 2021-22 to 2024-25, by street type and distance from the crash to the nearest school's grounds

byMode.what: The same kids, by how they were travelling

note: Written by tools/school-trips/school-kids-hurt.py. Kids 5 to 18 injured or killed on SF weekdays, 6 am to 6 pm, August to May, school years 2021-22 to 2024-25, from DataSF nwes-mmgh. Distances run to the nearest grounds of the tool's 219 schools, measured from the edge of the grounds as California's school-zone law measures it.
